repos.description: Interactive roadmaps, guides and other educational content to help developers grow in their careers.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个社区驱动的开发者学习路线图项目，提供前端、后端、DevOps、AI工程师、数据科学等30+技术方向的交互式可视化学习路径。用户可点击节点查看详细内容，涵盖从入门到进阶的完整技能体系，帮助开发者清晰规划职业发展和技术成长方向。
repos.summary_en: This community-driven project offers interactive visual learning roadmaps for developers across 30+ technical domains including frontend, backend, DevOps, AI engineering, and data science. Users can click nodes to access detailed content, covering complete skill paths from beginner to advanced levels, helping developers clearly plan career development and technical growth.

repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max Skill 是一款AI驱动的设计智能工具，通过100条推理规则和67种UI样式库，实现专业级设计系统的自动生成。支持多平台框架，提供Python CLI命令行接口，可快速分析项目需求并输出定制化UI/UX方案，涵盖从布局模式到视觉风格的完整设计体系，显著提升设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max Skill is an AI-powered design intelligence tool that automatically generates professional design systems using 100 reasoning rules and 67 UI style libraries. Featuring a Python-based CLI, it analyzes project requirements and outputs customized UI/UX solutions—from hero-centric conversion patterns to soft UI evolution styles—enabling rapid creation of cohesive, production-ready design systems across web and mobile platforms while dramatically improving design efficiency, ensuring brand consistency, and reducing development iteration cycles.

repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一个开源的 AI 代理编排平台，用于构建"零人力公司"。它通过 Node.js 服务端和 React 管理界面，协调多个 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）协同完成商业目标。核心功能包括组织架构管理、预算控制、目标对齐和任务追踪，让管理者像使用任务管理器一样 overseeing 整个 AI 团队。平台支持任意能接收心跳信号的代理，提供统一仪表盘监控工作进展和成本，实现 24/7 自动化运营，同时保留人工审计和干预能力。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for building "zero-human companies." It coordinates teams of AI agents through a Node.js backend and React dashboard, enabling autonomous business operations. The platform provides organizational charts, budget governance, goal alignment, and cost tracking across multiple agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Supporting any agent that can receive heartbeats, it functions as a task manager for AI teams, allowing 24/7 autonomous execution with human oversight. Users can define business goals, assign AI roles, and monitor progress from a unified interface, with pre-built company templates coming soon.

repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
repos.summary_zh: RuView利用商用WiFi的CSI信道状态信息，通过物理信号处理和机器学习实现穿墙人体感知。系统提供实时姿态估计(54K fps)、呼吸心率监测及毫秒级存在检测，无需摄像头或穿戴设备。基于Rust构建，支持ESP32-S3等低成本硬件，适用于智能安防、健康监护及灾难救援等隐私敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: RuView transforms commodity WiFi CSI signals into real-time human perception through physics-based signal processing and ML. It delivers 54K fps pose estimation, vital sign monitoring (breathing/heartbeat), and <1ms presence detection without cameras or wearables. Built in Rust with 1100+ tests, it supports ESP32-S3 and research NICs for through-wall sensing up to 5m. Ideal for privacy-preserving smart home, healthcare, security, and disaster response applications.

repos.description: The open-source CapCut alternative
repos.summary_zh: OpenCut 是开源的 CapCut 替代品，提供 Web、桌面和移动端视频编辑。基于 Next.js 和 React 构建，采用 Zustand 状态管理与 TypeScript 类型安全。支持时间线多轨道编辑和实时预览，核心优势是隐私优先（视频本地处理）、无订阅费用和水印，为商业闭源编辑器提供强大替代方案。
repos.summary_en: OpenCut is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut that provides comprehensive video editing capabilities for web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Built on Next.js and React with Zustand state management, it delivers timeline-based multi-track editing with real-time preview. The project emphasizes privacy by processing videos entirely on-device, eliminating subscriptions and watermarks. Leveraging TypeScript, Bun, and Docker, OpenCut offers a streamlined development experience and a robust, privacy-first substitute for commercial video editing solutions.

repos.description: The web framework for content-driven websites.
repos.summary_zh: Astro 是内容驱动网站的 Web 框架，强调服务端渲染与轻量输出。通过岛屿架构实现交互优化，支持 React 等框架集成和 Markdown 内容集合。默认零 JavaScript，具备快速构建、视图过渡和多平台部署功能。适用于博客、文档站点等内容应用，提供卓越性能与灵活扩展性。
repos.summary_en: Astro is a web framework optimized for content-driven websites, delivering powerful developer experience alongside lightweight output. It uses server-first rendering and the islands architecture for selective interactivity and minimal JavaScript. Astro supports integrations with React, Vue, Svelte and other frameworks, along with Markdown content collections. Features include zero JS by default, view transitions, optimized images, and deployment adapters. It excels in building blogs, documentation sites, and marketing pages with fast builds and excellent performance.

repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.summary_zh: Astryx 是 Meta 开源的设计系统，基于 React 19 与 StyleX，提供 150+ 无障碍组件、主题定制、暗黑模式及 CLI 工具。其开放内部结构支持任意层级组合与源码抽取，样式无锁定，可无缝对接 Tailwind 等方案，并专为人类开发者与 AI 智能体协同构建而优化。
repos.summary_en: Astryx is an open-source design system from Meta, built on React 19 and StyleX, offering 150+ accessible components, theming, dark mode, and a CLI. Its open internals allow composition at any level and source ejection, with no styling lock-in, enabling seamless integration with Tailwind and other CSS approaches, designed for both human developers and AI agents.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
repos.summary_zh: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
repos.summary_en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

repos.description: 🔥 Clone and recreate any website as a modern React app in seconds
repos.summary_zh: Open Lovable 是 Firecrawl 团队开源的 AI 驱动 React 应用生成器。通过对话式交互，用户可快速克隆并重构任意网站为现代化 React 应用。核心集成 Firecrawl 网页抓取、多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq）及 Vercel/E2B 沙盒环境，实现从 URL 到可运行代码的秒级生成，支持快速迭代与实时预览，适用于原型设计与网站迁移。
repos.summary_en: Open Lovable is an open-source AI-powered React app generator by the Firecrawl team. It enables instant cloning and modernization of any website into React applications through conversational AI interaction. The project integrates Firecrawl for web scraping, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq), and sandbox environments (Vercel/E2B) to transform URLs into runnable code within seconds, supporting rapid prototyping and website migration with real-time preview capabilities.

repos.description: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
repos.summary_zh: Readest 是一款基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建的开源电子书阅读器，覆盖桌面、移动及 Web 全平台。支持 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等主流格式，提供分屏并行阅读、代码语法高亮、全文检索与智能笔记等深度功能，专为追求沉浸式体验的深度阅读者打造。
repos.summary_en: Readest is a modern, open-source ebook reader engineered for immersive reading experiences. Leveraging Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it delivers native performance across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and web platforms. Supporting EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, TXT, and experimental PDF formats, it features split-screen parallel reading, code syntax highlighting, full-text search, dictionary lookup, and comprehensive annotation tools. Built as a sophisticated rewrite of Foliate, Readest combines powerful library management with customizable reading settings to serve avid readers and technical professionals.

repos.description: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
repos.summary_en: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供1,324个健身动作的综合数据集，每个动作包含动画GIF、180×180缩略图、身体部位/器械/目标肌肉/肌群元数据，以及9种语言的分步指导说明。作为LogPress AI健身追踪应用的底层数据，支持健身应用开发、运动识别推荐的机器学习项目、健康研究及教育原型。亮点包括结构化JSON文件与验证模式、纯客户端交互浏览器（搜索筛选多语言详情）、开发者工具（多数据库SQL生成、API示例及LLM后端提示），媒体按Gym visual许可使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a ready-to-use dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with animated GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, metadata on body parts, equipment, targets and muscle groups, plus step-by-step instructions in 9 languages. It powers the LogPress AI-assisted workout tracker and supports fitness app development, ML exercise recognition/recommendation, health research, and education. Highlights include validated JSON with schema, client-side interactive browser with search/filters/multilingual details, and developer tools offering DB SQL generators, API examples across languages, and LLM prompts for backend generation. Media licensed from Gym visual.

repos.description: A full-featured, hackable Next.js AI chatbot built by Vercel
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的全功能AI聊天机器人模板，基于Next.js 14 App Router与React Server Components构建。集成Vercel AI SDK提供统一LLM API，默认支持xAI，可无缝切换OpenAI等提供商。采用shadcn/ui组件与Tailwind CSS样式，数据持久化依托Neon Serverless Postgres和Vercel Blob存储，内置Auth.js认证。支持一键部署至Vercel，为开发者提供开箱即用的可扩展聊天应用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's open-source, full-featured AI chatbot template built with Next.js 14 App Router and React Server Components. Powered by Vercel AI SDK for unified LLM API access, defaulting to xAI while supporting seamless integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, and other providers. Features shadcn/ui components styled with Tailwind CSS, data persistence via Neon Serverless Postgres and Vercel Blob storage, and Auth.js authentication. Enables developers to quickly build and deploy hackable chatbot applications with one-click Vercel deployment.

repos.description: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎 — 基于倪海厦《天纪》体系，含完整排盘算法、四化系统、格局知识库、古籍原文数据
repos.summary_zh: 紫微斗数开源排盘引擎基于倪海夏《天纪》体系，提供完整排盘算法、四化系统、1100+格局知识库及古籍原文。核心亮点是51.8万条命盘样本数据（5.5GB），可用于AI模型微调和RAG检索。技术栈采用TypeScript与Next.js 14，支持移动端适配，助力传统文化数字化与命理研究。
repos.summary_en: This open-source Ziwei Dou Shu astrology engine implements Ni Haixia's "Tian Ji" system, featuring complete charting algorithms, four transformations, 1100+ pattern knowledge base, and classical texts. It provides 518,000 chart samples (5.5GB) for AI model fine-tuning and RAG retrieval. Built with TypeScript and Next.js 14, it enables traditional metaphysics research, AI training data generation, and digital divination applications with modern web technologies, including mobile adaptation and theme switching.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo是首家工业级全流程AI影视生产平台，通过AI Agent实现小说到视频的全自动改编。支持剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜制作、AI配音等好莱坞标准工作流，基于Next.js全栈框架与Docker容器化部署，为短剧和漫画视频创作提供可控、高效的生产解决方案。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is the industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film and video production. It automates the entire workflow from novel text to finished videos, featuring AI script analysis, character/scene generation, storyboard production, and multi-voice synthesis following Hollywood-standard pipelines. Built on Next.js 15 full-stack framework with Docker containerization, MySQL database, and Redis queue system, it delivers an industrial-grade solution for short drama and manga video creation, enabling scalable, efficient, and consistent content generation for professional creators.

repos.description: AI that sees your screen, listens to your conversations and tells you what to do
repos.summary_zh: Omi是开源的AI第二大脑，实时捕捉屏幕与对话内容，自动生成转录、摘要及行动项。跨平台支持macOS、iOS、Android及可穿戴设备，采用Swift/Rust/Flutter技术栈，集成Deepgram语音识别与LLM大模型，构建具备长期记忆的智能助手，已获30万+专业人士信赖。
repos.summary_en: Omi is an open-source AI second brain that captures screen content and conversations in real-time, automatically generating transcripts, summaries, and action items. Built with Swift/Rust/Flutter for cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and wearables, it integrates Deepgram speech recognition and LLMs to create a memory-capable AI assistant. The system processes audio via GPU-accelerated VAD and diarization, storing data in Firestore with Redis caching. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals, it offers a chat interface that remembers all user interactions.

repos.description: Beautiful map components. 100% Free, Zero config, one command setup.
repos.summary_zh: mapcn 是一个免费开源的 React 地图组件库，提供零配置、一键集成的地图解决方案。基于 MapLibre GL 构建，深度集成 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 样式体系，支持主题感知、可组合组件、标记弹窗、路线绘制等核心功能，适用于快速开发美观的地图可视化应用。
repos.summary_en: mapcn is a free, open-source React map component library that provides zero-config, one-command setup for beautiful map visualizations. Built on MapLibre GL and styled with Tailwind CSS, it seamlessly integrates with shadcn/ui design patterns. Key features include theme-aware light/dark mode adaptation, composable map components, rich markers with popups and tooltips, route/path drawing capabilities, and built-in controls—enabling rapid development of sophisticated map-based applications.

repos.description: Turn your Notion workspace into a fast, customizable website. Built with Next.js + Notion API, with multi-platform deployment and no self-hosted server required.
repos.summary_zh: NotionNext是基于Next.js与Notion API构建的高颜值静态博客系统，支持Vercel等多种部署方案，实现零服务器成本的网站搭建。专为创作者设计，可将Notion页面无缝转化为博客内容，提供主题定制、SEO优化及自动化部署能力，大幅降低技术门槛。
repos.summary_en: NotionNext is a visually appealing static blog system built with Next.js and Notion API, supporting multiple deployment options like Vercel for zero-server website setup. Designed for creators, it seamlessly transforms Notion pages into blog content with theme customization, SEO optimization, and automated deployment, significantly lowering technical barriers.

repos.description: A free + OSS logo generator powered by Flux on Together AI
repos.summary_zh: 开源免费的AI标志生成器，基于Together AI上的FLUX.2 pro与FLUX.1 Kontext，几秒内生成品牌级Logo并导出完整品牌套件。无需账号即可使用，支持参考图上传、多风格与SVG导出。采用Next.js + TypeScript构建，UI基于Radix与Tailwind，可选Clerk认证与Upstash限流，适合设计师与创业者快速创建专业视觉标识。
repos.summary_en: Free open-source AI logo generator powered by FLUX.2 pro and FLUX.1 Kontext on Together AI. Creates brand-ready logos in seconds and exports a full brand kit, fully account-less. Supports reference image upload, multiple styles and SVG export. Built with Next.js + TypeScript, Radix + Tailwind UI, optional Clerk auth and Upstash rate limiting. Ideal for designers and founders needing professional visual identity fast.

repos.description: 🏋 Modern open-source fitness coaching platform. Create workout plans, track progress, and access a comprehensive exercise database.
repos.summary_zh: Workout.cool 是一个现代开源健身教练平台，支持创建个性化训练计划、追踪健身进度，并提供包含详细说明与视频演示的全面运动数据库。基于 Next.js 16、Prisma ORM 和 Feature-Sliced Design 架构构建，具备 Docker 自托管、多语言支持及 Stripe 集成，旨在为健身开源社区提供可靠、可维护的自托管解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Workout.cool is a modern open-source fitness coaching platform for creating personalized workout plans, tracking progress, and accessing a comprehensive exercise database with detailed instructions and video demos. Built on Next.js 16, Prisma ORM, and Feature-Sliced Design architecture, it supports Docker self-hosting, i18n, and Stripe integration, reviving reliable tools for the fitness open-source community.

repos.description: Animated components for design engineers. 150+ free shadcn/ui components, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 为设计工程师打造的UI组件库，提供92+可复制的AI智能体模式与4个全栈模板。基于Tailwind CSS开发，完全兼容Shadcn，支持一键复制、Next.js导出或v0导入，快速构建可访问的定制化界面。
repos.summary_en: UI component library for Design Engineers featuring 92+ copy-paste AI Agent patterns and 4 full-stack templates. Built with Tailwind CSS, fully Shadcn-compatible. Integrate via copy-paste, Next.js export, or v0 import for accessible, customizable interfaces.

repos.description: Open-source ThreeUI Community catalog with live interactive components and complete Community source.
repos.summary_zh: ThreeUI Community 是开源的 Three.js/WebGL 3D 组件与交互 Shader 目录，含 50 个父组件、164 个可浏览结果。提供实时预览、变体控制、源码查看与 React 封装包，支持 npm 安装。适用于落地页 Hero、3D 背景与视觉特效开发，MIT 许可，免登录获取完整社区实现。
repos.summary_en: ThreeUI Community is an open-source catalog of procedural Three.js/WebGL 3D components and interactive shaders, featuring 50 parent components and 164 browse results. It offers live previews, variant controls, source access, and a React package via npm. Ideal for hero sections, 3D backgrounds, and visual effects. MIT-licensed, no login required.

repos.description: DeepAudit：人人拥有的 AI 黑客战队，让漏洞挖掘触手可及。小白一键部署运行，自主协作审计 + 自动化沙箱 PoC 验证。支持 Ollama 私有部署 ，一键生成报告。支持中转站。​让安全不再昂贵，让审计不再复杂。
repos.summary_zh: DeepAudit 是国内首个开源的 AI 多智能体代码审计系统，通过自主协作审计和自动化沙箱 PoC 验证，大幅降低漏洞挖掘门槛。支持 Ollama 私有部署，提供一键式操作和可视化报告，已实战发现 49 个 CVE 漏洞。适用于企业安全自检、开源项目审计和安全研究，让专业级代码审计触手可及。
repos.summary_en: DeepAudit is China's first open-source AI multi-agent code auditing system that democratizes vulnerability discovery through autonomous collaborative auditing and automated sandbox PoC validation. Supporting Ollama private deployment with one-click operation and visual reporting, it has discovered 49 CVEs in production. Ideal for enterprise security self-checks, open-source project auditing, and security research.

repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
repos.summary_en: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram account into an unlimited, secure cloud storage drive. an Open-source desktop app built with Tauri, Rust, and React.
repos.summary_zh: Telegram Drive是一款开源跨平台桌面应用，利用Telegram API将账号转化为无限安全的云存储驱动。基于Tauri、Rust和React构建，提供熟悉的文件资源管理器界面，支持Saved Messages和Channels作为文件夹。核心亮点包括高性能虚拟滚动、媒体流式播放、内置PDF查看器、拖放上传、密码保护分享链接、本地REST API支持AI集成、代理及VPN优化。隐私优先，数据与密钥本地存储，无第三方服务器。兼容Windows、macOS、Linux及Android平台。
repos.summary_en: Telegram Drive is an open-source cross-platform desktop app that turns your Telegram account into unlimited, secure cloud storage. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it provides a familiar file explorer using Saved Messages and Channels as folders. Highlights include high-performance virtual scrolling, media streaming, built-in PDF viewer, drag-and-drop, password-protected shareable links, local REST API for AI integration, proxy/VPN optimization, and privacy focus with all data local and no third-party servers. Supports Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

repos.description: 高颜值第三方 B 站 React Native 客户端
repos.summary_zh: JKVideo 是一款基于 React Native 和 Expo 构建的高颜值第三方 B 站客户端，支持 Android、iOS 和 Web 三端。核心亮点包括完整的 DASH 视频播放系统（4K HDR）、实时弹幕同步、纯 TypeScript 实现的 WBI 签名算法，以及 Zustand 状态管理。提供扫码登录、下载管理和局域网分享功能，是跨平台视频应用开发的优秀实践。
repos.summary_en: JKVideo is a high-quality third-party Bilibili client built with React Native and Expo, supporting Android, iOS, and Web platforms. Key features include complete DASH video playback (4K HDR), real-time danmaku synchronization, pure TypeScript WBI signing algorithm, and Zustand state management. It offers QR code login, download management, and LAN sharing capabilities, serving as an excellent example of cross-platform video application development.

repos.description: 🤹 Access thousands of icons as components on-demand universally.
repos.summary_zh: unplugin-icons 是基于 Iconify 的通用图标组件库，提供超20万图标并支持150+图标集。通过按需加载机制仅打包实际使用的图标，显著减小构建体积。支持 Vite、Webpack 等主流构建工具及 React、Vue 3 等框架，具备自动导入、SSR/SSG 友好、自定义图标等特性，适用于现代前端项目。
repos.summary_en: unplugin-icons is a universal icon library leveraging Iconify, providing 200,000+ icons across 150+ sets. It enables on-demand loading to bundle only used icons, reducing bundle size. Compatible with major build tools (Vite, Webpack, Rollup) and frameworks (React, Vue 3, Svelte), it features auto-importing, custom icons, and SSR/SSG support without FOUC for modern web development.

repos.description: Terraink: The Cartographic Poster Engine that creates unique and customizable map posters
repos.summary_zh: TerraInk 是一款基于 OpenStreetMap 数据的地图海报生成引擎。用户可通过地理编码搜索全球任意地点，自定义配色主题、地图图层和字体样式，并导出高分辨率 PNG 打印文件。采用 Bun+React+TypeScript 全栈技术，集成 MapLibre 实现矢量地图渲染，为设计师和地理爱好者提供便捷的创意地图制作工具。
repos.summary_en: TerraInk is a cartographic poster engine that generates unique, customizable map posters using real OpenStreetMap data. The platform offers smart geocoding for global locations, a rich theme system with dozens of curated color palettes, detailed map layer controls for roads, water, parks and buildings, and flexible typography options with Google Fonts integration. Built on a modern Bun+React+TypeScript stack with MapLibre for vector tile rendering, it enables users to export print-ready high-resolution PNG posters at any dimension, serving as an accessible creative tool for designers, geography enthusiasts, and anyone seeking personalized map art.

repos.description: 📜 A minimalist personal website embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow.
repos.summary_zh: Shiro 是为 Mix Space 生态系统打造的极简主义个人网站主题，融合纸的纯净与雪的清新。基于 Next.js 16 App Router 构建，集成 Jotai 状态管理、Socket.IO 实时推送和 Motion 物理动画，Lighthouse 性能评分超 90。支持 Markdown 扩展、多语言、实时活动状态展示，提供优雅的写作与阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: Shiro is a minimalist personal website theme designed for the Mix Space ecosystem, embodying the purity of paper and freshness of snow. Built on Next.js 16 App Router with Jotai state management, Socket.IO real-time communication, and Motion physics-based animations, it achieves Lighthouse scores above 90. The theme features Markdown extensions, multilingual support via next-intl, real-time activity status, and a dedicated 'Recently' thoughts system, delivering an elegant writing and reading experience.

repos.description: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
repos.summary_zh: tududi是一款自托管任务管理工具，融合个人简洁性与专业项目组织能力。核心亮点包括智能递归任务系统（支持多种模式、完成触发机制）、Telegram集成、多层级结构（领域-项目-任务-子任务），以及24种语言支持。面向注重隐私与效率的个人及团队，提供开放API与响应式设计，实现数据自主可控的生产力提升。
repos.summary_en: tududi is a self-hosted task management tool that merges personal simplicity with professional project organization. Its core features include an intelligent recurring task system with multiple patterns and completion-based triggers, seamless Telegram integration, and a hierarchical structure (Areas > Projects > Tasks > Subtasks). Designed for privacy-conscious individuals and teams, it offers 24-language support, OpenAPI documentation, and responsive design for full data control and productivity across devices.

repos.description: Handwriting animation for the web. Supports any font or text.
repos.summary_zh: Tegaki 是一个网页手写动画库，能将任意字体转化为自然的手写动画效果。无需手动路径绘制或原生依赖，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架及多语言内置字体。适用于演示、教学、创意设计和视频制作场景，提供自定义字体生成和跨平台集成，技术实现纯 Web 且易于使用。
repos.summary_en: Tegaki is a powerful web library designed to transform any font into realistic animated handwriting effects. Without the need for manual path creation or native dependencies, it animates text stroke by stroke with natural timing. It provides seamless support for popular frameworks including React, Svelte, Vue, and SolidJS, along with built-in fonts covering multiple languages such as Latin, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean. This makes it perfect for use in presentations, educational materials, creative web designs, and programmatic video creation. Additionally, it includes tools for generating custom font bundles and easy cross-platform integrations.

repos.description: Modern Admin Dashboard Template built with Shadcn UI and Next.js 16
repos.summary_zh: 基于Next.js 16、TypeScript与Shadcn UI的现代化管理后台模板，提供CRM、财务等多场景仪表板。支持亮暗主题切换、响应式布局与同构文件系统架构，内置Tailwind CSS v4、Zustand状态管理和TanStack Table数据处理，助力快速构建可扩展的企业级应用。
repos.summary_en: Modern admin dashboard template built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Shadcn UI, featuring multiple pre-built dashboards for CRM, finance and other business scenarios. Supports light/dark theme switching with multiple color presets, responsive layouts, and colocation-based file system architecture for better code organization. Integrated with Tailwind CSS v4, Zustand for lightweight state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. Includes authentication flows and role-based access control (planned). Enables rapid development of scalable enterprise applications with customizable themes and flexible layouts.

repos.description: Components from design to production
repos.summary_zh: LiftKit是一个面向设计师的UI框架，通过数学公式自动实现设计最佳实践。核心提供缩放、间距和色彩的系统化解决方案，确保视觉对称、比例平衡和色彩平滑过渡。目前仅支持Next.js，正处于重写阶段以符合现代开发标准。项目由兼职维护者开发，暂不建议生产环境使用。其平台无关的设计系统可无缝集成到现代前端工作流中。
repos.summary_en: LiftKit is a UI framework for perfectionists that automatically enforces design best practices through mathematical formulas for scaling, spacing, and color. It ensures optical symmetry, balanced proportions, and smooth color ramps without manual effort. Currently Next.js-only, it's being rewritten with Base UI primitives to meet modern standards. The designer-built system is platform-agnostic and aims to make developers better designers. Maintained by part-time contributors, it's not production-ready yet but offers a robust foundation for design-system-driven development with community-driven expansion and Tailwind integration efforts.

repos.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.
repos.summary_zh: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
repos.summary_en: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

repos.description: Free, open-source web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, design your own visually, export as RDF/XML, and share interactive diagrams. Zero backend, fully static.
repos.summary_zh: Ontology Playground是一款免费开源的纯静态网页应用，专为学习本体论及Microsoft Fabric IQ语义建模设计。用户可浏览零售、医疗等六大领域预构建本体目录，使用可视化编辑器设计本体并实时预览Cytoscape.js交互图表，支持RDF/XML导入导出与GitHub一键PR提交。内置结构化学习课程、实验室、任务系统及嵌入式组件，采用React 19和TypeScript构建，无后端依赖。适用于数据工程师与AI开发者快速掌握企业知识图谱构建技能。
repos.summary_en: Ontology Playground is a free, open-source, fully static web app for learning ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ semantic modeling. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies across six domains like Retail and Healthcare, visually design with live Cytoscape.js graph previews, import/export RDF/XML, and submit PRs via GitHub. Features a learning hub with courses, labs, quests, and embeddable widgets. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, zero backend. Ideal for data professionals and AI developers mastering enterprise knowledge graphs.

repos.description: Render Anything Engine: tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games as React and TypeScript, rendered on your own GPU. Rust + Bevy, macOS, Linux and Windows.
repos.summary_zh: raea 是面向 AI 的渲染引擎，用自然语言描述需求，以 React/TypeScript 编写，在本地 GPU 渲染视频、动态图形、3D 和游戏。基于 Rust+Bevy，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。
repos.summary_en: raea is an AI-oriented rendering engine that lets you describe what to make in natural language, written as React and TypeScript, and rendered on your local GPU for videos, motion graphics, 3D, and games. Built with Rust and Bevy, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provides a desktop app and CLI tools, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, and can render frames, play live as a game, export standalone programs, and check quality issues such as clipped text or low contrast. Designed for AI-driven content creation, it enables anyone to generate professional-grade visuals quickly.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram Channel into a MicroBlog.
repos.summary_zh: BroadcastChannel 是一个基于 Astro 的工具，可将 Telegram 频道转化为轻量级微型博客。它无需浏览器端 JavaScript，提供 SEO 友好的站点地图和 RSS 订阅，支持 Cloudflare、Vercel 等无服务器部署。用户只需配置频道用户名，即可快速搭建独立博客，实现内容同步与自定义域名绑定。
repos.summary_en: BroadcastChannel transforms your Telegram channel into a lightweight microblog using Astro. It requires zero client-side JavaScript, delivers SEO-friendly sitemaps and RSS feeds, and supports deployment on serverless platforms like Cloudflare and Vercel. Simply configure your channel username to launch a standalone blog with custom domain support.

repos.summary_zh: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
repos.summary_en: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

repos.description: 🚀 Full-stack Next.js 15 + Cloudflare Workers template with D1 database, R2 storage, Better Auth, and Server Actions. Production-ready with automated CI/CD and generous free tiers.
repos.summary_zh: 该模板深度融合 Next.js 15 与 Cloudflare Workers 边缘计算平台，提供生产级全栈解决方案。核心亮点包括 D1 分布式 SQLite 数据库、R2 对象存储、Better Auth 认证体系及 Server Actions 数据交互，通过 Drizzle ORM 实现端到端类型安全。内置 GitHub Actions 自动化流水线与预览部署，充分利用 Cloudflare 免费层实现低成本启动，支持从 MVP 到企业级应用的无缝扩展。
repos.summary_en: This production-ready template integrates Next.js 15 with Cloudflare Workers edge computing, delivering a full-stack solution featuring D1 distributed SQLite database, R2 object storage, Better Auth authentication, and Server Actions. With end-to-end TypeScript via Drizzle ORM, automated CI/CD via GitHub Actions, and preview deployments, it leverages Cloudflare's generous free tier for cost-effective MVP development while scaling seamlessly to enterprise applications.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 与 Cloudflare 全栈构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等十余种渠道。项目采用边缘计算架构，通过 Cloudflare Pages 与 D1 数据库实现零成本部署，提供接口组批量推送能力。UI 基于 shadcn/ui 打造，兼具美观与易用性，适用于监控告警、自动化通知等场景。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source, adorable message push service built on Next.js and Cloudflare stack, supporting over 10 channels including DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, and more. Leveraging edge computing architecture with Cloudflare Pages and D1 database, it enables zero-cost deployment and batch push via group interfaces. The UI, crafted with shadcn/ui, combines aesthetics with usability. Ideal for monitoring alerts and automated notifications, it offers a developer-friendly solution with GitHub OAuth integration and seamless deployment.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图艺术生成工具，无需安装即可将全球城市地图转化为精美海报。采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端界面，Rust WASM 处理地图渲染，Bun 作为高性能运行时。支持亚洲、欧洲、美洲等数十个热门城市，提供即时预览与高清导出，是旅行纪念与城市美学创作的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map art generator that transforms city maps into stunning posters without installation. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust WASM for map rendering and Bun as the high-performance runtime. Supporting dozens of cities across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, it offers instant preview and HD export, ideal for travel memorabilia and urban aesthetic creation.

repos.description: 🤖 The largest directory for AI-ready documentation and tools implementing the proposed llms.txt standard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 llms.txt 标准的中央资源库，聚合了多种开发者工具与实现方案。通过标准化文档访问协议，指导 AI 模型精准理解项目文档，提升 AI 编程助手准确性与开发者体验。提供 Chrome 插件、VS Code 扩展、MCP 协议支持及 CLI 工具，覆盖主流开发环境，推动 LLM 与文档生态的互操作性。
repos.summary_en: The largest directory for the emerging llms.txt standard, curating production-ready implementations and developer tools across the ecosystem. It establishes a standardized protocol for how LLMs should access and interpret project documentation, significantly improving AI coding assistant accuracy and developer productivity. The hub provides Chrome extensions, VS Code plugins, Model Context Protocol integration, Raycast extensions, and CLI tools covering major development environments, fostering seamless interoperability between AI models and documentation ecosystems while setting clear boundaries for AI-content interaction.

repos.description: An isometric world‑builder set in Tolkien’s Middle‑earth, where you create and shape your own landscapes inspired by its iconic lands and lore.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于托尔金中土世界的等距地图构建工具，支持7大种族领地和混合模式。采用Next.js 16、React 19和TypeScript 5技术栈，提供3x3至20x20的网格编辑、6类地形瓦片、角色叠加和拖拽绘制功能。支持PNG/JSON导入导出、撤销操作、本地存储和社区地图共享。适用于游戏原型设计、粉丝创作和地理可视化场景，具备深度链接加载和瓦片回退机制。
repos.summary_en: An isometric map builder set in Tolkien's Middle-earth featuring 7 distinct realms and mixed-mode support. Built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript 5, it offers grid-based editing (3x3 to 20x20), 6 tile categories, character overlays, and click/drag painting. Key features include PNG/JSON import/export, undo support, Zustand-powered localStorage persistence, and community collections. Ideal for game prototyping, fan creations, and geographic visualization, with deep-link loading and automatic tile fallback mechanisms.

repos.description: How top iOS apps say hello | 10 animated welcome screens inspired by top-earning apps. Rebuilt in React Native + Expo.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 React Native Expo 项目，收录 10 个受 Duolingo、Strava 等热门 iOS 应用启发的动画欢迎/启动/引导屏幕。每个均为完整 TypeScript 组件，基于 Reanimated 实现精准时间轴动画、响应式缩放、无障碍与减动画支持。开发者可直接运行画廊、复制组件或粘贴 AI 提示词快速集成，专为学习高端移动端 onboarding 设计而打造。
repos.summary_en: Open-source React Native Expo kit with 10 animated welcome, splash and onboarding screens inspired by top iOS apps like Duolingo and Strava. Each is a full TypeScript component powered by Reanimated, featuring authored timelines, responsive scaling, reduced-motion and accessibility support. Run the gallery, copy any component or paste AI prompts to integrate polished mobile onboarding UI for study or production use.

repos.summary_zh: Shadcn Builder 是为 shadcn/ui 量身打造的可视化表单构建器，通过拖拽式操作和实时预览，让开发者无需编写代码即可创建美观、可访问的表单。工具直接生成生产就绪的 React + Tailwind CSS 代码，完美契合 shadcn/ui 组件体系，实现零配置快速上手，大幅提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Shadcn Builder is a powerful no-code form builder specifically designed for the shadcn/ui component library. It enables developers to visually create beautiful, accessible forms through drag-and-drop interface with live preview, then exports clean, production-ready React + Tailwind CSS code. With zero configuration required and seamless shadcn/ui integration, it dramatically accelerates frontend development while maintaining code quality and type safety.

repos.description: Curated Motion Core Svelte components
repos.summary_zh: 面向Svelte 5的精选生产级动效组件库，采用shadcn式copy-paste架构，通过CLI直接注入源码。封装GSAP与OGL，实现流畅WebGL与时间轴动画，覆盖磁力按钮、3D无限画廊等，专为实验性高性能网页设计打造。
repos.summary_en: Curated production-ready motion components for Svelte 5, using a shadcn-inspired copy-paste architecture via CLI. Wraps GSAP and OGL for smooth WebGL and timeline animations, including magnetic buttons and 3D galleries, focused on high-end experimental web motion design.

repos.description: An out‑of‑the‑box Next.js + Cloudflare full‑stack starter integrating Edge Runtime, D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, Analytics Engine hooks, and a complete CI/CD pipeline.一个开箱即用的 Next.js + Cloudflare 全栈项目模板，集成 Edge Runtime、D1 数据库、R2 存储和完整的 CI/CD 流程。
repos.summary_zh: 一个开箱即用的Next.js + Cloudflare全栈模板，专为边缘计算场景打造。基于vinext实现4倍构建加速和57%包体积缩减，深度集成D1数据库、R2存储、KV缓存和Analytics Engine。内置better-auth认证、next-intl国际化、Vitest测试和完整CI/CD流水线，提供生产级环境变量验证、结构化日志和自动化迁移验证。适用于需要高性能、低成本、全球部署的现代化Web应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Production-ready Next.js + Cloudflare full-stack starter for edge computing. Leverages vinext for 4x faster builds and 57% smaller bundles, deeply integrating D1 database, R2 storage, KV cache, and Analytics Engine. Features better-auth authentication, next-intl i18n, Vitest testing, and complete CI/CD pipeline with production-grade environment validation, structured logging, and automated migration verification. Ideal for high-performance, low-cost, globally-deployed modern web applications.

repos.description: 一款功能强大的 Nginx 配置文件可视化编辑工具
repos.summary_zh: nginx-flow 是一款基于 React Flow 的 Nginx 配置可视化编辑器，通过拖拽式画布构建 server/location/upstream 节点，实现配置即编程。内置生产级模板库覆盖 SPA、反向代理、负载均衡等场景，集成智能体检引擎可自动检测安全风险与性能问题并提供一键修复，支持实时配置预览与流量模拟，显著提升运维效率与配置准确性。
repos.summary_en: nginx-flow is a visual Nginx config editor built on React Flow, transforming manual configuration into drag-and-drop canvas programming with server/location/upstream nodes. It features production-ready templates for SPA, reverse proxy, load balancing, and smart audit engine that auto-detects security risks and performance issues with one-click fixes. Real-time config preview, traffic simulation, and bilingual support streamline DevOps workflows, reducing errors and accelerating deployment.

repos.description: Open-source SRS
repos.summary_zh: Memcode 是一款专为开发者与学习者设计的现代化间隔重复闪卡应用。核心亮点在于深度融合编程学习场景，支持代码块、LaTeX公式与多媒体内容，并集成 OpenAI 高质量文本转语音。其 LLM 友好的纯文本导入导出格式，便于 AI 辅助知识管理，实现美观、高效、无摩擦的学习体验。
repos.summary_en: Memcode is a modern spaced repetition flashcard app designed for developers and learners. It excels in programming education with support for code blocks, LaTeX formulas, and multimedia. Integrated OpenAI text-to-speech delivers high-quality audio, while LLM-friendly plain text import/export enables seamless AI-powered knowledge management, combining beauty with effortless learning.

repos.description: 📚 Character relationship maps
repos.summary_zh: Austen是一款AI驱动的文学分析工具，通过集成DeepSeek/OpenAI自动解析书籍角色关系，并生成Mermaid可视化图谱。基于Next.js全栈框架与Supabase后端，支持用户管理、图表保存(SVG/PNG)与社交分享，为教育、阅读及文学研究提供直观的关系探索体验。
repos.summary_en: Austen is an AI-powered literary analysis tool that automatically extracts character relationships from books using DeepSeek/OpenAI and visualizes them via Mermaid diagrams. Built on Next.js fullstack with Supabase backend, it enables user management, graph export (SVG/PNG), and social sharing—ideal for educators, readers, and literary research to visually explore narrative dynamics.

repos.summary_zh: HiDeck 是一款自托管的 Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G 调制解调器管理控制台，通过浏览器统一管理 USB 蜂窝模块，支持代理绑定、短信收发、WiFi 通话、VoLTE、eSIM 管理及定时任务自动化，采用 Go + Vue 3 构建，Docker 一键部署。
repos.summary_en: HiDeck is a self-hosted web console for managing Qualcomm 4G/LTE/5G cellular modems through a browser interface. It supports USB modem auto-discovery across QMI, MBIM, AT, and PC/SC protocols, SOCKS5/HTTP proxy binding, SMS inbox and sending, WiFi calling, native VoLTE, eSIM provisioning, and scheduled task automation with notifications via Telegram, email, Bark, Feishu, and WeChat. Built with Go and Vue 3, it deploys via Docker with SQLite storage, supporting both binary and containerized installation for Linux systems with multi-language documentation.

repos.description: Read premium articles for free with this Bookmarklet
repos.summary_zh: Readium 是一个轻量级书签工具，通过 JavaScript 技术绕过付费墙限制，让用户免费访问 Medium、Substack 等平台的优质内容。项目采用 Vue.js 构建官方网站，部署于 GitHub Pages，提供一键式便捷操作。相比浏览器扩展，书签形式无需安装，更加便携高效，是数字内容自由访问的实用解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Readium is a lightweight bookmarklet that bypasses paywalls to provide free access to premium content on platforms like Medium and Substack. Built with Vue.js and deployed on GitHub Pages, it offers a one-click solution without requiring browser extension installation. This portable tool leverages JavaScript to remove content restrictions, delivering a streamlined alternative to traditional ad-blockers or subscription management tools for effortless reading of gated articles. Its open-source nature ensures transparency and community-driven improvements.

repos.description: 🤖 An AI-powered desktop automation agent built with Electron &   Next.js - Control your computer like manus, but as a native   desktop app, an ai browser!
repos.summary_zh: 基于Electron与Next.js的AI桌面自动化浏览器，实现类Manus的计算机控制。核心特性：双模式交互（ChatAgent轻量对话/Deep Explore多智能体工作流）、多模态任务执行、可视化定时调度。支持DeepSeek/Qwen/Gemini等AI提供商，集成Tavily/Serper搜索与MCP服务。采用React 19+Zustand架构，提供原生桌面体验，适用于智能办公、研究分析与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered desktop automation browser built with Electron and Next.js that enables Manus-like computer control through a native application. Key features include dual-mode interaction (ChatAgent for lightweight conversations vs. Deep Explore for multi-agent workflows), multi-modal task execution, and visual scheduling. Supports major AI providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Claude) with integrated search engines (Tavily/Serper) and MCP services. Built on React 19+Zustand architecture, it delivers native desktop experience for intelligent office work, research analysis, and automation scenarios.

repos.description: Video to ASCII React component.
repos.summary_zh: react-video-ascii 是一个基于 WebGL2 的高性能 React 组件，可将视频实时转换为 ASCII 艺术。支持自定义字符集、亮度/饱和度调节及字形/亮度双渲染模式。内置鼠标悬停高亮/散射、点击波纹/扩散动画及加载揭示效果。适用于创意编码、艺术展示和网页特效场景，通过 GPU 加速确保流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: react-video-ascii is a high-performance React component that converts videos to ASCII art in real-time using WebGL2 acceleration. It offers extensive customization including character sets, brightness/saturation controls, and dual rendering modes (shape/luminance). Features interactive mouse hover effects (brighten/scatter), click animations (ripple/spread), and reveal transitions. Ideal for creative coding, artistic displays, and web experiments with smooth GPU-accelerated rendering.

repos.description: OneDrive public directory listing, and One-Click Deploy to Vercel. Powered by Vercel and Next.js.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 和 Vercel 的 OneDrive 目录列表程序，支持一键部署。通过将配置迁移至 Vercel 环境变量，省去手动修改配置文件的繁琐步骤，实现快速上线。提供文件预览、下载功能，支持文件夹密码保护，并优化 OAuth 认证流程以增强安全性，适合免费搭建私有文件分享站点。
repos.summary_en: A OneDrive directory listing solution built with Next.js and Vercel, featuring one-click deployment. By migrating configurations to Vercel environment variables, it eliminates manual config file editing, enabling rapid setup. Offers file preview and download capabilities, supports password-protected folders, and enhances OAuth security by auto-closing authentication channels.

repos.description: An AI-assisted newsroom workflow system for event tracking, evidence organization, approval chains, correction handling, and post-publication monitoring.
repos.summary_zh: NewsFlow 是一款 AI 辅助的新闻编辑室工作流系统，专注于新闻生产中高成本、高责任的中间流程。系统通过 AI 智能体实现线索归并、证据结构化、风险审查、签发审批和发布后监测，建立完整的人机协同审核机制。采用 FastAPI+React 技术栈，支持自托管和二次开发，为新闻机构提供可审计、可追溯的数字化协作平台。
repos.summary_en: NewsFlow is an AI-assisted newsroom workflow system focusing on the high-cost, high-responsibility intermediate processes of news production. It employs AI agents to handle lead clustering, evidence structuring, risk assessment, approval chains, and post-publication monitoring, establishing a comprehensive human-in-the-loop review mechanism. Built with FastAPI+React stack, it supports self-hosting and secondary development, providing news organizations with an auditable, traceable digital collaboration platform for editorial governance and fact-checking workflows.

repos.description: minimalism, blog theme for Astro
repos.summary_zh: Astro Air 是一款基于 Astro 框架的极简多语言博客主题，支持中、英、日、韩等五种语言，内置置顶文章、阅读时长、目录导航、暗色主题及 RSS 订阅等丰富功能。采用 Bun 作为包管理器和运行时，提供流畅的动画交互与响应式布局，适合追求简洁与性能的个人博客站点。
repos.summary_en: Astro Air is a minimal multilingual blog theme built on Astro, supporting five languages including English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. It features pinned posts, reading time, table of contents, dark mode, and RSS feeds. Powered by Bun for fast tooling, it delivers smooth animations and responsive layouts, ideal for personal blogs prioritizing simplicity and performance.

repos.description: 一个基于 Next.js 开发的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理私服，支持一键部署到Vercel。解决国内 Pull 镜像困难问题。
repos.summary_zh: Pocker 是基于 Next.js 的全栈 Docker 镜像仓库管理系统，专为解决国内 Docker Hub 拉取缓慢而设计。系统通过 GitHub Actions 自动化将镜像转存至华为云 SWR，支持一键 Vercel 部署、多区域节点切换、镜像/标签/命名空间全生命周期管理，并提供用量统计与暗黑模式。让每个人都能拥有自主可控的 Docker 私服。
repos.summary_en: Pocker is a full-stack Docker registry management system built with Next.js, designed to solve slow Docker Hub pulls in China. It automatically transfers images to Huawei Cloud SWR via GitHub Actions, enabling one-click Vercel deployment. Key features include multi-region node switching (23 global nodes), complete lifecycle management of images/tags/namespaces, usage statistics, dark mode, and automated workflows. It empowers individuals and teams to own private Docker registries with full data control and security.

repos.description: A modern personal time management and task tracking application
repos.summary_zh: Fates 是一款基于 Tauri 和 Svelte 构建的开源时间管理与任务追踪应用。它通过可视化时间轴、热力图和数据分析帮助用户识别时间黑洞，内置 AI 助手可优化任务描述并自动生成周报。采用本地优先存储策略保障隐私，支持多端同步，旨在解决职场人士时间管理混乱、工作效率低下及周报总结困难等痛点。
repos.summary_en: Fates is a modern open-source time management and task tracking application built with Tauri and Svelte, designed to help professionals combat productivity challenges. It features visual timeline views, GitHub-style calendar heatmaps, and comprehensive data analytics to reveal time consumption patterns. The integrated AI assistant optimizes task descriptions, auto-generates weekly reports, and provides intelligent scheduling suggestions. Employing a local-first storage architecture for privacy protection, it supports seamless synchronization across web and desktop platforms. Fates directly addresses common pain points: disorganized time management, inefficient workflows, and the tedious process of weekly reporting, making it an ideal tool for self-improvement and career development.

repos.description: Static File Browser by Astro
repos.summary_zh: 基于Astro的静态文件浏览器，专为Cloudflare Pages设计。构建时扫描public目录生成预渲染HTML，提供现代化目录列表界面，支持MDX内容注入、SEO优化及自定义错误页。解决静态托管平台缺乏autoindex功能的问题，适合需要美观、可浏览文件索引的场景。
repos.summary_en: A static file browser built with Astro for Cloudflare Pages. Pre-renders directory listings at build time with modern UI, MDX support, SEO optimization, and custom error pages. Solves the lack of autoindex on static hosting platforms, ideal for creating browsable file indexes with zero server-side logic.

repos.description: Turn a private Hugging Face repo into your own cloud storage service.
repos.summary_zh: Hugging Cloud 将私有 Hugging Face 仓库转化为自托管云存储服务，专为 AI 团队管理模型与数据集设计。基于 FastAPI+Next.js 全栈架构，提供 RBAC 权限控制、可恢复上传和签名链接安全访问。Docker 容器化部署，支持 SQLite/Postgres 和 Redis，兼顾轻量便捷与生产级扩展能力。
repos.summary_en: Hugging Cloud transforms private Hugging Face repositories into self-hosted cloud storage services, purpose-built for AI teams managing models and datasets. Built on a modern FastAPI+Next.js stack, it delivers enterprise-grade features including RBAC access control, resumable uploads, and cryptographically signed download links. Docker containerized deployment supports both SQLite for lightweight use and Postgres/Redis for production scalability, enabling seamless integration into existing AI infrastructure while maintaining data privacy and access governance.
